rules: Every new guide is added here AND gets a real file under src/content/guides/. tools/new_guide.py does both, and the build fails if the two disagree (CHK-12).
A guide with an empty claims table does not get published. There is no auto-fill.
No guide is written about a product whose link_state is pending unless it is question-shaped and names no product.
